description: Total cost of ownership for a product and team size: sourced line items (licenses with price escalation, benchmark implementation), year-one + multi-year totals, effective per-seat cost. The defensible "true cost for an N-person team" answer.

slug.description: Product slug (e.g. "salesforce") or product name (e.g. "HubSpot CRM"). Near-misses return did-you-mean suggestions.

tier.description: Tier name as listed by get_pricing (default: cheapest paid tier). An unknown tier returns the available tiers.

name: calculate_tco
